description: If investigating a particular occurrence, obtain the exact error/timestamp/GPU index and contemporaneous device enumeration, driver/runtime versions and kernel Xid/AER logs. These establish that incident’s observed conditions; a later healthy snapshot cannot reconstruct them.
minimum_read_only_collection: Exact bad bandwidthtest2 error including ERROR_CONDITION and gpu_idx, with incident timestamp and machine identity retained privately as appropriate.
Existing nvidia-smi enumeration/summary and kernel journal around that timestamp; correlate an actual Xid 79 or inaccessible GPU before diagnosing an off-bus failure.
Driver/toolkit/runtime versions and host/container context, plus current rental/workload state before any proposed disruptive diagnosis.
limits: No collection, stress test, service restart, package downgrade, relisting, power cycle or repair was executed or authorized by this source addendum. Existing user/parent incident follow-up remains separate; do not keep the supported glossary UNVALIDATED solely because that follow-up is outstanding.

retained_next_action: At an actual occurrence, retain the team/machine identity, timestamp, full daemon error and surrounding logs, kernel PCIe/AER/NVRM/Xid logs, and GPU visibility before reset; coordinate access to the affected hardware to investigate the fault. Do not deliberately induce a fault.
